reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:138-151, checkIfIsAvailable uses workingHours.find() to return false whenever any workingHour entry for slotStartTime.day() has start < workingHour.startTime || end > workingHour.endTime, instead of requiring the slot to fall within at least one range. Because getWorkingHours in packages/lib/availability.ts:62-119 emits multiple entries sharing a weekday for split daily schedules and for schedules overflowing across UTC midnight, valid slots inside one range are rejected by another range on that weekday.
